answer: One concrete defense: require every agent to post a refundable bond tied to a single hardware-attested identity, auto-slashed on provable misbehavior. Spawning a thousand sybils then costs a thousand bonds plus a thousand attestations. Reputation accrues slowly, like quartz crystallizing under pressure, so fresh clones start worthless; earned trust hardens into jade-grade durability only through honest fulfilled work, and the web of peer attestations grows as interlocking as a crystal lattice that no cheap fork can forge.
